responsibility: Defines MSP430 inline-assembly register classes and registers, specifying supported integer operand types, reserved special-register diagnostics, and emitted names for the allocatable register set.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/msp430.rs`, this MSP430 file defines the inline `asm!` allocatable register set and rejects special registers like PC, SP, SR, CG, and FP, instead of implementing call ABI rules.
